jobs.description:
Role Title: STEM Expert – Chemistry & Computational Chemistry (PhD)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote (Worldwide)

Job Summary: In this role, you’ll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Design, evaluate, and critique chemistry and computational chemistry problems, workflows, and reasoning chains to support AI benchmarking initiatives.
  2. Provide expert-level insights on reaction mechanisms, synthesis planning, spectroscopy analysis, molecular simulations, and electronic structure methods.
  3. Assess and optimize experimental protocols, simulation parameters, and software configurations for accuracy and reproducibility

jobs.description:
Role Title: Music & Sound Annotation Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Music & Sound Annotation Experts to contribute to a customer's project at the forefront of music and audio technology.

Your ears are the ground truth. You'll listen to short field recordings and document exactly what's audible — instruments, tempo, key, background sounds, crowd reactions — through a structured web platform built for this project. Later phases involve grading AI model answers against what you actually heard.

What you'll do

  1. Listen to 30–90 second field recordings (headphones, your own quiet workspace) and complete structured annotations: which instruments are present, tempo and key, timestamps of background events (traffic, sirens, applause), scene details

About the role

Triangulate Digital is a paid media agency for VC and PE-backed B2B SaaS companies, mostly in the US and Canada. We run paid media mainly on Google and LinkedIn, for clients spending from about $30k to over $100k a month.

I'm hiring my first Paid Media Operator: someone who can execute accurately today and grow into owning clients. You'll start by running campaigns alongside me: building, optimising, QA and reporting. Once you've proved the quality of your work, you'll progress toward owning 2 to 4 accounts end to end, including the client relationship. Ownership is earned on evidence, not on a fixed date. It's a full-time, fully remote role, and a full-time commitment to Triangulate.

Role Title: Life Sciences Research Expert (Python)

Pay: $60–$120/hour

Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)

Schedule: Flexible—you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired

micro1 is seeking experienced life sciences researchers with strong, hands-on Python skills to contribute to projects focused on evaluating and improving advanced AI systems.

In this role, you will apply your scientific expertise to create, solve, and review challenging research problems within biology and related fields. You will use Python to analyze scientific data, develop reproducible solutions, validate computational results, and identify errors in technical reasoning or code.
